svg.title: B2, the graph alone: one-vs-rest reliability per condition
svg.desc: Raw scores: the graph's posterior, a softmax of its log-likelihoods. EXP-007's rule chose Platt scaling for B2; the raw scores are drawn here. For each condition, every patient's probability for it, binned in tenths: across, the bin's mean probability; up, the share of the bin's patients who have the condition. The diagonal is perfect calibration; hollow points hold fewer than 20 patients (their counts are in exp023_error_analysis.json and on hover). Under each panel, the condition's ECE at each level with its 95% bootstrap interval. * must-not-miss. Validation split, 33,963 patients. DDXPlus is synthetic, so these figures describe its generator, not real patients. Closed world: only 13 conditions can be named (R-13). Evidence masked by docs/05 §3.7 (digests e99a7a8fbf792675 / af3a357f6454838a): the same patients at every level, each 25% history inside its 50% one; the masks remove answers at random, which a clinician's questions do not. The component alone, not fused. EXP-023. B2 is the knowledge graph alone, built from the DDXPlus definitions that generated these patients, so its figures are circular (R-12).

svg.text: For each condition, every patient's probability for it, binned in tenths: across, the bin's mean probability; up, the share of the bin's patients who have the condition. The
diagonal is perfect calibration; hollow points hold fewer than 20 patients (their counts are in exp023_error_analysis.json and on hover). Under each panel, the condition's ECE at
each level with its 95% bootstrap interval. * must-not-miss. Validation split, 33,963 patients. DDXPlus is synthetic, so these figures describe its generator, not real patients.
Closed world: only 13 conditions can be named (R-13). Evidence masked by docs/05 §3.7 (digests e99a7a8fbf792675 / af3a357f6454838a): the same patients at every level, each 25%
history inside its 50% one; the masks remove answers at random, which a clinician's questions do not. The component alone, not fused. EXP-023. B2 is the knowledge graph alone,
built from the DDXPlus definitions that generated these patients, so its figures are circular (R-12).
